epic.spec:
# Undo/Redo History Dropdown

## Overview

Add dropdown menus to Undo/Redo toolbar buttons showing recent actions with timestamps and diff previews. Users can hover to see history, click any item to undo/redo to that point, and navigate via keyboard.

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Backend: Timestamp field in UndoEntry, stack exposure commands, multi-step undo/redo
- Frontend: Dropdown component, detail preview popup, keyboard navigation
- Integration: Toolbar button modifications, chevron indicator
- Tests: E2E Playwright tests

**Out of scope:**
- Branching undo tree (linear history only)
- Touch device support (hover-based, revisit later)
- Configurable history limit (uses existing 100-entry limit)

## Architecture

### Data Flow
```
User hovers Undo → 300ms delay → invoke('get_undo_stack') → Render dropdown
User clicks item N → invoke('undo_to', {index: N}) → N undos execute → refreshProjectState()
```

### Key Files
- `src-tauri/src/core/undo.rs:23-29` - UndoEntry struct (add timestamp)
- `src-tauri/src/commands/history.rs` - Add get_undo_stack, undo_to commands
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/Toolbar.tsx:55-60` - Undo/Redo buttons
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/DisplayMenu.tsx` - Dropdown pattern to follow

### New Types
```typescript
// Frontend DTO
interface UndoHistoryItem {
  index: number;
  description: string;
  timestamp: string; // ISO 8601
  commandType: string; // For icon mapping: "create_section", "delete_shot", etc.
}
```

```rust
// Backend DTO
#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct UndoHistoryItem {
    pub index: usize,
    pub description: String,
    pub timestamp: String, // ISO 8601
    pub command_type: String,
}
```

## Approach

1. **Backend first**: Add timestamp to UndoEntry, expose stack via new commands
2. **Component shell**: Build dropdown with hover trigger, no preview yet
3. **Detail preview**: Add hover preview with positioning logic
4. **Keyboard nav**: Integrate with existing shortcut system
5. **Polish**: Animations, icons, truncation, scrolling

## Key Decisions

- **Timestamp storage**: `DateTime<Utc>` in UndoEntry, migrate existing entries with `None` (display as "Unknown")
- **Multi-step semantics**: Execute undos sequentially (not transactional) - partial state on failure is acceptable
- **Stack data**: Fetch on dropdown open (not eagerly) to avoid performance overhead
- **Preview data**: Include in stack response (simpler than separate call)
- **Icons**: Text icons like existing toolbar (↖, ✋) - consistent with current design

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Stack changes while dropdown open | Close dropdown on Ctrl+Z/Y keyboard shortcuts |
| Large batch preview data | Collapse to summary for >5 items |
| Legacy entries without timestamps | Display "Unknown" for null timestamps |

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Run dev server
./scripts/dev.sh

# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run Playwright tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

# Smoke test: hover undo button, verify dropdown appears
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Hovering Undo/Redo buttons shows dropdown after 300ms delay
- [ ] Dropdown displays up to 10 recent actions, scrollable for more
- [ ] Each item shows icon, description (truncated at ~40 chars), and timestamp
- [ ] Clicking any item executes undo/redo to that point
- [ ] Hovering items shows detail preview with diff (old → new values)
- [ ] Timestamps use smart hybrid format (relative <1 day, absolute otherwise)
- [ ] Backend stores timestamp with each UndoEntry
- [ ] New Tauri commands: get_undo_stack, get_redo_stack, undo_to, redo_to
- [ ] Buttons have small chevron indicator
- [ ] Keyboard: Arrow Down opens, arrows navigate, Enter selects, Escape closes
- [ ] Empty stacks don't show dropdown
- [ ] Preview flips to left if would overflow right edge
- [ ] Dropdown closes on Ctrl+Z/Y keyboard shortcuts

## References

- DisplayMenu.tsx pattern: `src/components/SingleSystemView/DisplayMenu.tsx:36-213`
- Escape key coordination: `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:276` (data-dropdown-open)
- Command description method: `src-tauri/src/core/command.rs:216-297`
- date-fns formatDistanceToNow: https://date-fns.org/docs/formatDistanceToNow
- ARIA menu pattern: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/

## Doc Updates Needed

- SPEC.md Section 6.2: Document dropdown behavior
- SPEC.md Appendix A: Add dropdown keyboard shortcuts
- SPEC.md Section 8: Document timestamp field
- TESTING.md: Add dropdown testing section

# fn-14-3zg.2 Backend: Multi-step undo_to and redo_to commands

## Description
Add undo_to and redo_to commands that execute multiple undo/redo operations to reach a specific history point.

**Size:** S
**Files:**
- `src-tauri/src/commands/history.rs` - Add undo_to, redo_to commands
- `src-tauri/src/core/state.rs` - Add methods to AppState
- `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` - Register new commands

## Approach

1. Add `undo_to(index: usize)` command that loops calling existing `undo()` logic
2. Add `redo_to(index: usize)` command similarly
3. Return CommandResult with success/error
4. If any step fails, stop and return error (partial state is acceptable per spec)

## Key Context

- Existing `undo()` implementation at `state.rs:1736`
- Existing `redo()` implementation at `state.rs:1875`
- Can reuse these methods in a loop - no need for transaction semantics
## Acceptance
- [ ] undo_to(index) executes (current_index - target_index) undos
- [ ] redo_to(index) executes (target_index - current_index) redos
- [ ] Returns CommandResult with error if any step fails
- [ ] Commands registered in lib.rs

# fn-14-3zg.3 Frontend: UndoHistoryDropdown component with hover trigger

## Description
Create UndoHistoryDropdown React component with hover trigger (300ms delay), scrollable list of up to 10 items, action icons, truncated descriptions, and timestamps.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/UndoHistoryDropdown.tsx` - New component
- `src/store/projectStore.ts` - Add fetchUndoStack/fetchRedoStack actions
- `src/types/commands.ts` - Add UndoHistoryItem type

## Approach

1. Follow DisplayMenu.tsx pattern at `DisplayMenu.tsx:36-213` for dropdown structure
2. Use useState for isOpen, useRef for click-outside detection
3. Implement 300ms hover delay with setTimeout/clearTimeout
4. Add `data-dropdown-open` attribute for Escape key coordination (see `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:276`)
5. Render list with icons, truncated description (~40 chars), relative timestamps
6. Use date-fns formatDistanceToNow for timestamps (install if needed)
7. Scrollable container with max 10 items visible, auto-hide scrollbar

## Key Context

- Icon mapping: create_section→"+", update_shot→"✏", delete_section→"✕", merge_stations→"⊕", etc.
- Match existing toolbar icon style at `Toolbar.tsx:90-100`
- Use CSS `text-overflow: ellipsis` for truncation
- For relative time <1 day, use formatDistanceToNow; otherwise show date
## Acceptance
- [ ] Dropdown appears after 300ms hover delay
- [ ] Dropdown closes on mouse leave (with small delay buffer)
- [ ] Shows up to 10 items, scrollable for more with auto-hide scrollbar
- [ ] Each item shows: icon, description (truncated ~40 chars), timestamp
- [ ] Timestamps: relative for <1 day ("2 min ago"), absolute for older
- [ ] data-dropdown-open attribute set when open
- [ ] Click on item calls undo_to/redo_to and closes dropdown
- [ ] Empty stack shows no dropdown (relies on canUndo/canRedo)
- [ ] pnpm tsc --noEmit passes

## Description
Add detail preview popup that appears when hovering items in the dropdown, showing old→new field values with smart viewport positioning.

**Size:** M
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/UndoHistoryDropdown.tsx` - Add preview sub-component
- `src-tauri/src/commands/history.rs` - Extend UndoHistoryItem with preview data (or add separate command)

## Approach

1. Add preview data to UndoHistoryItem: key fields based on command type
2. For shots: length, azimuth_in, depth_in/out + "+X more" if additional fields
3. For sections: name, surveyor, date
4. Preview appears to right of dropdown on item hover
5. Detect viewport overflow - flip to left if would overflow right edge
6. Use 150ms fade-in animation (CSS @keyframes)
7. Respect prefers-reduced-motion

# fn-14-3zg.5 Frontend: Keyboard navigation for dropdown

## Description
Add keyboard navigation to the undo/redo dropdown: Arrow Down to open, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select, Escape to close.

**Size:** S
**Files:**
- `src/components/SingleSystemView/UndoHistoryDropdown.tsx` - Add keyboard handlers
- `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts` - Ensure dropdown Escape takes priority

## Approach

1. When button focused, Arrow Down opens dropdown and focuses first item
2. Arrow Up/Down navigates items with roving tabindex pattern
3. Auto-scroll to keep selected item visible
4. Enter executes selected item action
5. Escape closes dropdown and returns focus to trigger button
6. Coordinate with existing Escape handling via data-dropdown-open attribute

## Key Context

- ARIA menu pattern: role="menu" on list, role="menuitem" on items
- Use aria-activedescendant to track focus without moving DOM focus
- See memory note: "Keyboard event handler state - use refs for values needed in handlers"
- Existing dropdown Escape check at `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:276`
## Acceptance
- [ ] Arrow Down on focused button opens dropdown
- [ ] Arrow Up/Down navigates items in list
- [ ] Selected item auto-scrolls into view
- [ ] Enter executes selected item action and closes dropdown
- [ ] Escape closes dropdown and returns focus to button
- [ ] ARIA attributes: role="menu", role="menuitem", aria-activedescendant
- [ ] Works with screen readers (test with accessibility tools)
- [ ] pnpm tsc --noEmit passes
